scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev -w @boboland/server" "npm run dev -w @boboland/client"
scripts.play: npm run build && npm run start:open
scripts.play:online: npm run build && npm run online -w @boboland/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
